def max_path_sum(root):
    best = float('-inf')

    def gain(node):                    # best downward chain from node
        nonlocal best
        if not node:
            return 0
        l = max(gain(node.left), 0)    # clamp: drop negative branches
        r = max(gain(node.right), 0)
        best = max(best, node.val + l + r)
        return node.val + max(l, r)

    gain(root)
    return best

def build_tree(preorder, inorder):
    index = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(inorder)}
    pre = 0                            # next root in preorder

    def build(lo, hi):                 # subtree over inorder[lo..hi]
        nonlocal pre
        if lo > hi:
            return None
        root = TreeNode(preorder[pre])
        pre += 1
        mid = index[root.val]
        root.left = build(lo, mid - 1)     # left first: preorder order
        root.right = build(mid + 1, hi)
        return root

    return build(0, len(inorder) - 1)

def build_tree(preorder, inorder):
    if not preorder:
        return None
    root = TreeNode(preorder[0])
    mid = inorder.index(root.val)      # O(n) scan for every root
    root.left = build_tree(preorder[1:mid + 1], inorder[:mid])
    root.right = build_tree(preorder[mid + 1:], inorder[mid + 1:])
    return root
